Title: AIR-C24 - installation speaker
Product Description: AIR-C series sets a new standard for small-format permanent installations for retail, entertainment, malls, and club settings. With a rich Hi-Fi sound quality and solid SPL performance AIR-C speakers are nevertheless compact, easy to install and tune, and fully customizable. The secret of the series’ ultimate performance is low distortion high-performing transducers and a proprietary Polycomp© wood/polyurethane composite cabinet technology. It allowed for the special cabinet form that eliminates internal standing waves. Not only that, the composite dramatically reduces the cabinet resonances itself, bringing clarity and intelligibility to a whole new level. With a small visual footprint, the AIR-C24 is a high-performing system with two 4” woofers and an HF driver on a rotatable horn. It is compatible with horizontal and vertical adjustable mountings and is available in 8 Ohm for ease of parallel usage.
